entities.name: UniProt Q8EAC7
observations: Exact 467-aa query sequence match to reviewed Shewanella oneidensis cytochrome c-552 (UniProt Q8EAC7).
Annotated as cytochrome c nitrite reductase (ammonia-forming), EC 1.7.2.2; reduces nitrite to ammonia using six electrons.
Binds five covalent heme c groups and one Ca2+ per monomer according to reviewed annotation.
Annotated localization: periplasm; biological processes include anaerobic electron transport and nitrate/nitrogen assimilation.
